rv.q: Santa’s First Christmas might not give us the man himself in the bright red suit we all know and love, but it’s a cheerful and charming addition to the festive season.
Beautifully choreographed, musically engaging and genuinely heartwarming, this festive production reminds us that those who spend their lives caring for others deserve to be cared for, too.

cn.t: Critics praise *Santa's First Christmas* as a delightful festive treat, with standout direction and charming performances winning over audiences at the Unicorn Theatre.
